objectives.text: Each member must develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor the member's compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations.

citations.quote: Each member shall develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor the member's compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. 5311, et seq.), and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury.

obligations.action: develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations

citations.quote: Each member shall develop and implement a written anti-money laundering program reasonably designed to achieve and monitor the member's compliance with the requirements of the Bank Secrecy Act (31 U.S.C. 5311, et seq.), and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Department of the Treasury.

obligations.action: have its anti-money laundering program approved, in writing, by a member of senior management

citations.quote: Each member's anti-money laundering program must be approved, in writing, by a member of senior management.

obligations.action: establish and implement policies and procedures that can be reasonably expected to detect and cause the reporting of transactions required under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g) and the implementing regulations thereunder

citations.quote: Establish and implement policies and procedures that can be reasonably expected to detect and cause the reporting of transactions required under 31 U.S.C. 5318(g) and the implementing regulations thereunder;

obligations.action: establish and implement policies, procedures, and internal controls reasonably designed to achieve compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and the implementing regulations thereunder

citations.quote: Establish and implement policies, procedures, and internal controls reasonably designed to achieve compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and the implementing regulations thereunder;

obligations.action: provide for annual (on a calendar-year basis) independent testing for compliance, conducted by member personnel or a qualified outside party
obligations.trigger: member executes transactions for customers, holds customer accounts, or acts as an introducing broker with respect to customer accounts
exceptions: unless the member does not execute transactions for customers or otherwise hold customer accounts or act as an introducing broker with respect to customer accounts (e.g., engages solely in proprietary trading or conducts business only with other broker-dealers), in which case independent testing is required every two years (on a calendar-year basis)

citations.quote: Provide for annual (on a calendar-year basis) independent testing for compliance to be conducted by member personnel or by a qualified outside party, unless the member does not execute transactions for customers or otherwise hold customer accounts or act as an introducing broker with respect to customer accounts (e.g., engages solely in proprietary trading or conducts business only with other broker-dealers), in which case such "independent testing" is required every two years (on a calendar-year basis);

obligations.action: designate and identify to FINRA (by name, title, mailing address, e-mail address, telephone number, and facsimile number) an individual or individuals responsible for implementing and monitoring the day-to-day operations and internal controls of the program, who must be an associated person of the member, and provide prompt notification to FINRA regarding any change in such designation(s)

citations.quote: Designate and identify to FINRA (by name, title, mailing address, e-mail address, telephone number, and facsimile number) an individual or individuals responsible for implementing and monitoring the day-to-day operations and internal controls of the program (such individual or individuals must be an associated person of the member) and provide prompt notification to FINRA regarding any change in such designation(s);

obligations.action: provide ongoing training for appropriate personnel

citations.quote: Provide ongoing training for appropriate personnel; and

obligations.action: include appropriate risk-based procedures for conducting ongoing customer due diligence, including understanding the nature and purpose of customer relationships to develop a customer risk profile, and conducting ongoing monitoring to identify and report suspicious transactions and, on a risk basis, to maintain and update customer information (including beneficial ownership information for legal entity customers)

citations.quote:
Include appropriate risk-based procedures for conducting ongoing customer due diligence, to include, but not be limited to:
(i) Understanding the nature and purpose of customer relationships for the purpose of developing a customer risk profile; and
(ii) Conducting ongoing monitoring to identify and report suspicious transactions and, on a risk basis, to maintain and update customer information.

obligations.action: undertake more frequent independent testing than required if circumstances warrant

citations.quote: All members should undertake more frequent testing than required if circumstances warrant.

obligations.action: have independent testing under Rule 3310(c) conducted by a designated person with a working knowledge of applicable requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations

citations.quote: Independent testing, pursuant to Rule 3310(c), must be conducted by a designated person with a working knowledge of applicable requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and its implementing regulations.

obligations.action: have independent testing conducted by a person who performs the functions being tested, the designated anti-money laundering compliance person, or a person who reports to either such person

citations.quote:
Independent testing may not be conducted by:
(1) a person who performs the functions being tested,
(2) the designated anti-money laundering compliance person, or
(3) a person who reports to a person described in either subparagraphs (1) or (2) above.

obligations.action: identify, review, and, if necessary, update the information regarding its anti-money laundering compliance person designated pursuant to Rule 3310(d), in the manner prescribed by Rule 4517

citations.quote: Each member must identify, review, and, if necessary, update the information regarding its anti-money laundering compliance person designated pursuant to Rule 3310(d) in the manner prescribed by Rule 4517.

notes: Rule 3310 uses 'shall' in its opening sentence and 'must' in the very next sentence for what appear to be parallel program-establishment duties (development/implementation vs. senior-management approval); both are extracted per the text's own modal word without harmonizing. Paragraph (c)'s independent-testing frequency requirement is drafted as a single conditional rule (annual default, biennial exception) rather than as two separate obligations, and is extracted as one conditional row to preserve that structure. Several terms central to the rule's operation (customer risk profile, independent testing, anti-money laundering compliance person, member) are used but not defined within Rule 3310 itself and are recorded as '(undefined here)' per instructions.
